description:
Implement WhatsApp through shared linked-device infrastructure, with multiple connector configurations and disabled history sync. Dependency work: zaq-hjp and zaq-meb; reuse zaq-zho for history/replay control.

User-approved architecture decision (2026-10-11): introduce/reuse provider-neutral linked-device integration, not a WhatsApp-only lifecycle/UI. Inspect the newly added Credentials device-connection behavior first and extend it where compatible; do not duplicate it or assume linked-device pairing is OAuth2. Shared responsibilities: exact connector/credential association, runtime lifecycle contract, normalized pairing states, QR presentation/expiry/retry, and protected state persistence. JidoChatBridge delegates to shared linked-device integration. Provider adapter owns protocol handshake, profile resolution, event translation and provider-specific settings. WhatsApp/Amarula owns sync_history=false and sync_full_history=false, Amarula connection behavior and storage namespace translation. QR is one pairing presentation method, not a protocol. Preserve multiple concurrent connector configurations with isolated profile/state/connection and exact outbound selection. Bridge supplies custom storage adapter; Amarula invokes callbacks; adapter synchronously dispatches explicit NodeRouter Events to Engine Credentials/Connect protected storage. Propagate callback-compatible read/write/timeout outcomes; do not acknowledge persistence before success. Omit storage_root to avoid overriding custom storage; sink_mfa is not a persistence channel. Fix underlying ownership on crash/stop/restart without orphan connections. Test common contract using a second minimal fake provider as well as Amarula contract tests, without inventing a second production integration. New module names and persistence schema remain proposed pending inspection of existing device behavior. No live account connection authorized.

Planned dependent steps: shared configuration/provider binding -> encrypted state storage + Amarula adapter -> shared lifecycle + WhatsApp operations -> exact-connector ingress/egress -> zaq-zho sync/admission -> shared pairing status/retry -> shared BO pairing UI -> human UX approval -> E2E -> review/coverage. Reuse prior QR renderer, provider presentation and useful tests; replace old lookup/lifecycle/supervisor/retry defects. Child issues and prerequisite links have been created. Planning only; no implementation or external messaging.

Execution order:
zaq-hjp -> zaq-meb -> zaq-0l7.1 -> zaq-0l7.2 -> zaq-0l7.3 -> zaq-0l7.4 -> zaq-zho -> zaq-0l7.5 -> zaq-0l7.6 -> zaq-0l7.7 -> zaq-0l7.8 -> zaq-0l7.9

Reuse from previous implementation:
- Adapter registration intent adapted to Engine owner
- linked_device listener classification
- Skip unsupported token/URL auth probes
- Stable config-ID profile concept through one resolver
- Adapter control envelopes as pairing status
- Safe QR matrix renderer, Storybook, applicable tests
- Provider card/label and token-free config validation intent

Replace from previous implementation:
- Provider-only lookup and inconsistent profiles
- Profile omitted from typing/reactions and other operations
- Orphan connection and stale sink lifecycle
- Dynamic start calls against current static supervisor
- Discarded restart errors and stale QR timers
- Unwired environment storage configuration
- Old bridge bodies that predate current normalization and identity contracts

Open decisions:
- Queued offline-message catchup policy differs from history sync and needs explicit decision informed by provider metadata
- Choose supported stop/adopt implementation at lifecycle boundary
- Establish single connector owner across nodes before distributed enablement
- Locate and inspect newly added ZAQ device-connection behavior and confirm protected state persistence contract before implementing storage adapter
